{{Top|leg}}
'''D/Crypt technicians''' were employees of [[D/Crypt Information Services]], a corporation based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. On-site [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] and data retrieval were two of the main responsibilities for a D/Crypt technician. [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] once owned by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], was successfully broken into by a [[Unidentified D/Crypt technician|D/Crypt lead technician]] hired by fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]].
